from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum


class NotificationChannel(str, Enum):
    SLACK = "slack"
    EMAIL = "email"
    PIPELINE_COMMENT = "pipeline_comment"


@dataclass
class ExceptionNotification:
    """Notification generated by the exception system."""
    exception_id: int
    channel: NotificationChannel
    recipient: str
    subject: str
    body: str
    urgency: str  # info, warning, critical


def generate_notifications(actions: list[dict]) -> list[ExceptionNotification]:
    """Converts review actions into concrete notifications."""
    notifications = []

    for action in actions:
        if action["action"] == "expired":
            # Urgent notification to owner and security lead
            notifications.append(ExceptionNotification(
                exception_id=action["exception_id"],
                channel=NotificationChannel.SLACK,
                recipient=action["owner"],
                subject=f"Exception #{action['exception_id']} expired",
                body=(
                    f"The exception for {action['finding_id']} has expired. "
                    f"The finding will block the pipeline again on the "
                    f"next PR touching the affected component."
                ),
                urgency="critical"
            ))

        elif action["action"] == "expiring_soon":
            urgency = "warning" if action["days_remaining"] > 7 else "critical"
            notifications.append(ExceptionNotification(
                exception_id=action["exception_id"],
                channel=NotificationChannel.SLACK,
                recipient=action["owner"],
                subject=(
                    f"Exception #{action['exception_id']} expires "
                    f"in {action['days_remaining']} days"
                ),
                body=action["message"],
                urgency=urgency
            ))

    return notifications
